description: The redirect_uri shape `fishhawk token login --oauth` generates (cli/cmd/fishhawk/oauthlogin.go loopbackRedirectURI) and the PORTLESS loopback URI the operator registers for it. Shared across modules (E66.5 / #2393, approval condition 4): the CLI test asserts it GENERATES this shape and that cli/README.md documents this register command; the backend test drives the shape through oauthas.MatchRedirectURI / ResolveRedirectURI so the RFC 8252 §7.3 port relaxation is proven on the matcher that actually runs, without the CLI module importing backend internals.
register_command: fishhawkd oauth client register --client-id fishhawk-cli --redirect-uri http://127.0.0.1/callback --token-endpoint-auth-method none --grant-type authorization_code --grant-type refresh_token
